_comment: A worked example of the file the Portfolio Manager hands over.
The contract is docs/portfolio-import.md. Unknown fields -- this one
included -- are ignored at every level, so PM can carry whatever it
likes alongside what the copier reads.
Drop this on a slave in Settings -> Risk -> Import to see the plan.
It is a dry run until Apply is pressed.
